messages:
lola (release-coordinator): Kicking off canary for release v3.4.1 to us-west-2 — 10% traffic. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Please follow the backout runbook if we see regressions: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started. Canary ID: c-2210001234. Targets: canary-7 (3 pods). Image: rwinf/service:v3.4.1. CI: #build-2045.

simon (eng-release): noted. I'll watch error budget and latency dashboards. If 5xx spike > 1.5x baseline for 3m we revert per runbook.

maria (oncall): +1 watching SLOs. Setting alert mute to 5m for noisy tests. Ping me @maria if you want an immediate backout.

akash (infra): quick heads up — autoscale profile for canary set to min=3 max=6. If we need emergency unpin, keep the older image ready: rwinf/service:v3.4.0.

elaine (prod-eng): reminder from runbook step 2: prepare pinned rollout command and skaffold anchor. Putting rollback commands here in case:```
# rollback and pin to previous stable
rwinf deploy pin --service service --version v3.4.0 --reason "emergency backout"
rwinf deploy promote --canary-id c-2210001234 --action abort
```

lola (release-coordinator): thanks. If we abort, we follow the backout checklist: 1) pin v3.4.0, 2) abort canary, 3) evict canary kv cache, 4) notify customers. Link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout#checklist

deploy-bot: Canary health checks: 2/3 ok, 1 pod RestartCount=1 (OOMKilled). Logs: `OOMKilled` on worker-1.

simon (eng-release): OOMs are worrying. Is this reproducing on 3.4.0? Maria can you check memory graphs and config? If this is new, follow runbook severity path B -> backout.

maria (oncall): Checking now. Heap usage trend up ~15% compared to v3.4.0. I can throttle canary traffic to 5% to buy time, or we can abort now.

lola (release-coordinator): I'd prefer quick abort to avoid customer impact. Decision: abort canary, pin to v3.4.0. @akash can you run the pin and abort? Put status updates here. :wave:

akash (infra): Running commands now.```
# pin and abort
rwinf deploy pin --service service --version v3.4.0 --reason "OOM regression in canary"
rwinf deploy promote --canary-id c-2210001234 --action abort
```

deploy-bot: Action accepted. Rollback triggered. Pin event: pin-98765 by akash. Canary abort in progress.

lola (release-coordinator): Evicting KV cache as per runbook step 3. akash/maria coordinate cache eviction.

akash (infra): Eviction started: `redis-cli -h kv-canary flushdb` (running on maintenance window).

maria (oncall): Monitoring. SLOs returning to baseline. No further 5xx rise.

elaine (prod-eng): Filing a post-abort blameless note and flagging for root-cause in next triage. Also adding a test to catch memory regression.

lola (release-coordinator): Closing loop: canary aborted, pinned to v3.4.0, cache evicted. Follow-ups: 1) RCA (prod-eng), 2) improved mem test in CI (eng-release), 3) decision on hotfix vs patch release (PM). Good work everyone. :clap:

simon (eng-release): Adding links to the runbook and playbook artifacts for the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/ops/postmortems/post-2210001234
